unit_text: I keep telling myself that consistency matters more than sincerity, but I don't believe that all the way through.
Part of me wants a clean principle; part of me only wants relief.
I wrote three lines in the notebook about freedom, crossed them out, and then rewrote the last line.
I am not angry at Mira, or at least I keep insisting that I'm not angry.
What I actually feel is smaller and sharper than that, more like embarrassment.
The essay by Weil is still on my desk, and I keep reading the sentence about attention as if it could decide things for me.
